title: Expectations & Definitions of Success: Part 2
summary: Kahran and Divya continue their season-long examination of success — separating contentment from achievement, revisiting their 'clean fuel vs dirty fuel' framework for motivation, and walking through Kahran's London client engagement at 25 as a case study in what made a period of life feel successful in retrospect. They land on growth, presence, autonomy and mastery as recurring ingredients.

intents.display: to question what success actually means and feels like
